summary: Comprehensive codebase survey of 22 files under Cslib/Logics/Propositional/ plus 2 external embedding files. The refactor adds and/or constructors to the Proposition inductive (Defs.lean), removes botE from the ND system and replaces it with 6 new constructors (andI, andE1, andE2, orI1, orI2, orE) matching upstream Waring's 10-rule system, extends all 3 Hilbert axiom sets with 6 and/or axiom schemata, and updates all recursive functions on Proposition (subst, Evaluate, IForces, etc.) with 2 new cases each. Estimated ~860 lines changed across 21 files in 7 phases. The DerivedRules.lean [IsClassical T] constraints on andE1/andE2/orE become moot as these become primitive ND rules. Key risk: completeness proofs (3 files) and ND-Hilbert bridge (Equivalence.lean). Recommend keeping HasAxiom* typeclasses standalone (not bundled into MinimalHilbert) to avoid cascading breakage to Modal/Temporal/Bimodal until tasks 174-176.
